aboutUs.title: ABOUT US
aboutUs.text-1: We offer over 130 types of beer, delivery straight to your door, gift certificates, and amazing partnership deals starting from a case of beer! We’re always happy to welcome you to our bar in Budva, where you can enjoy beer in a fun, friendly atmosphere.
aboutUs.text-2: Discover new flavors, bring your friends or colleagues, and we’ll take care of the good vibes! Don’t miss out on discounts and special offers by becoming part of our beer family!
